api_keys_type_check.name: api_keys_type_check
api_keys_type_check.value:
(type = 'organization' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL) OR 
    (type = 'personal' AND organization_id IS NULL)

embeddings_stats_check.name: embeddings_stats_check
embeddings_stats_check.value:
chunk_index >= 0 AND token_count >= 0 AND 
    (start_page IS NULL OR start_page >= 0) AND 
    (end_page IS NULL OR end_page >= 0)

knowledge_bases_stats_check.name: knowledge_bases_stats_check
knowledge_bases_stats_check.value: document_count >= 0 AND total_tokens >= 0 AND total_size_bytes >= 0 AND embedding_dimension > 0
